description: Start a billed analysis proposing database keys, SQL types, indexes and relationship ownership on a linked schema. Requires editor. Registration already starts the initial pass; use this after relevant edits. Incremental scope covers new properties or changed JSON types/multilingual flags; an empty scope does not rerun unchanged fields. Returns job_id: poll get_job_status and inspect get_schema's working copy. Correct proposals with property tools, then publish_schema to ship changes. Entity-level indexes and ownership choices: enricher://docs/database-sync.

model.description: Model composite key; leave it on auto (the default). auto is YOUR model, or with use_platform_models=true the organization's best model for this task from its benchmark scores (quality/speed/cost weights), within the run's constraints (attachments, web search, thinking) — the result reports the pick as model_selection. Name a provider::model only when the user named one; that runs the job on the platform (billed). Keys: list_models. On the platform, auto runs the schema's own model (set at generation or in the schema editor), else the best schema-generation model.
model.title: Model

use_platform_models.description: false (default): every LLM call of this job runs on YOUR model — the job parks each call as a pending request you answer with answer_llm_request; no credits are consumed. true: the job runs on the platform (billed) and, with the model left on auto, on the organization's best model for the task — its highest blended benchmark score under the organization's quality/speed/cost weights, among the models that satisfy the run (attachments, web search, thinking). Naming a platform model also runs the job there, bypassing that pick: do it only when the user named one. Protocol: enricher://docs/llm-delegation.
use_platform_models.title: Use Platform Models
